editorial:
Imagine you can't sleep for days and you're convinced someone is messing with your head. That is exactly where you find Jay, a guy who is totally exhausted and desperate. He decides to hire James, a private eye who thinks he has seen it all, to track down the mysterious person causing his insomnia. The vibe is a weird mix of a detective story and a comedy, making you wonder if you should be laughing or feeling nervous for the main character. It starts off as a simple search, but you quickly realize that Jay is hiding some pretty big secrets that could ruin his life if James digs too deep.

The acting is top-notch, and the chemistry between the two leads keeps the story moving quickly. You will love the unexpected turns in the plot, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. If you enjoy stories where nothing is as it seems, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover the big twist: there is no outside villain. Jay has been sleepwalking and causing all the chaos himself due to his own guilt over a past crime. James finds the evidence in Jay's own house, proving Jay was the mystery figure. Once Jay accepts the truth and confesses to his mistakes, his mind finally relaxes. He is able to fall asleep for the first time in weeks, bringing the story to a peaceful close.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty mysteries and quirky characters.
